title: HallThruster.jl parametric feasibility envelope of the H-1 Hall accelerator and the decisive 196-state two-layer closure classification (A9.32)
registered_before: any HallThruster.jl run on any H-1 case. No Hall result for H-1 exists anywhere in the repository; the container that wrote this cannot install Julia (julialang-s3.julialang.org / pkg.julialang.org 403). The only Hall results ever seen by the project are the P5-Xe identification and P5-N2 v1 campaign records (P5 geometry), which are not H-1 results.
what_this_is: the preregistered case grid, assumptions, run-status rule, output schema and decision rules of the A9.32 parametric Hall envelope for H-1
the preregistered two-layer reporting and A9.32 classification rule of the decisive 196-state closure run, including its NOT_DETERMINABLE branch
what_this_is_not: not a validation and not an admission: the credible Hall transport set stays EMPTY; HallMap admission, the admitted-member loader and the hall_ensemble admission logic are unchanged
not a design Hall map: no envelope record is a Hall map, enters HallMap, or enters layer (b)
not an H-1 design selection: geometry points are FEMM analysis points, B(z) shapes are surrogates
not a change to the P5-N2 v1 outcome (INCONCLUSIVE, permanent) or to any pin, frozen dataset or admitted record
not new transport: no parameter is tuned, retuned or interpolated; no super-Bohm set is used
hard_rules: HR-01 credible set EMPTY is unchanged; layer (a) results never enter layer (b); every layer (a) field carries PARAMETRIC / NOT_VALIDATED
HR-02 transport only from registered records (transport_ensemble_v0.json screening_candidates, all a = 1/16 <= 1/16); no super-Bohm, no retuning to any target
HR-03 no invented geometry, B(z), operating point or rate data: every axis value below cites its source; the B(z) gap is declared (sec. bz_family)

HR-04 Xe uses the pinned HallThruster.jl built-in Xe; the only Hall air chemistry is abep-n2n-0.11 (runs beyond its domain are OUT_OF_DOMAIN, never feasible); no Hall O / O2 chemistry exists and atomic O is never replaced by N2: N2 runs are labelled N2_PROXY
HR-05 run statuses follow the registered P5 rule structure; only converged, sustained, chemistry-trustworthy runs count toward feasibility
HR-06 HallThruster.jl pin unchanged (v0.23.1, bfb3019fc74ceaa2c70c9d3b19236a83a44ee3b5, Julia 1.11.7); every run records commit, Julia version, thread / BLAS environment and case hash

HR-07 PHYSICALLY_NON_CLOSING only from non-closure demonstrated by evaluated physics under the favorable envelope; never from missing evidence or planning allocations; otherwise NOT_DETERMINABLE with the blocking list
pinned_inputs_note: the per-propellant rate tables referenced by n2_n.toml are re-hashed by bridge_lib.jl's own guards at run time; the case file and driver produced after this lock are hash-pinned in the launch manifest (sec. execution_provenance)

families.chemistry: builtin-Xe (HallThruster.jl v0.23.1 built-in tables; bridge run_case allowed_charges [1])
families.chemistry_domain_check: none available: the built-in Xe tables have no project validity manifest; every Xe record carries the limitation XE_CHEMISTRY_NO_VALIDITY_MANIFEST and chemistry never makes an Xe run OUT_OF_DOMAIN (same observation as hall_transport_v2_prereg_DRAFT chemistry.xenon)
families.mdot_label: XE_FLOW_FROM_H1_ATM_RANGE: no H-1 Xe flow is registered (xe_accounting_a9_v3 XV2-17 / XV2-18 TBD); the Xe axis reuses the registered H-1 mass-flow values

families.chemistry: abep-n2n-0.11 nominal (COMPLETE_FOR_P5_N2_VALIDATION; domain T_e 2-30 eV, mean energy 3-45 eV)
families.chemistry_domain_check: bridge_lib.jl chemistry_validity: f_out <= 1e-12 for every reaction over every saved frame and cell, and no unresolved table (p5_n2_run_status_rule_v1 chemistry_trust_rule, never relaxed)
families.classification_role: NONE. N2_PROXY: pure N2 at the delivered mass flow. The delivered air has atomic O at 5.0-86.0 % of the inflow over the required states (input audit AUD-CHEM) and there is no Hall O / O2 chemistry. N2 is not a bound in either direction (O is lighter, which lowers thrust per power at equal efficiency, and has a lower ionization energy and no molecular losses, which raises ionization efficiency). N2_PROXY results are reported in their own diagnostic block and never enter the AIR_PRIMARY layer (a) feasibility, the PHYSICALLY_NON_CLOSING branch or the SELECT_WITH_EVIDENCE_CONDITIONS branch.
families.air_layer_a: AIR_PRIMARY layer (a) Hall quantities are NOT_EVALUATED with reason AIR_HALL_O_O2_CHEMISTRY_NOT_ADMITTED (an honest AIR Hall envelope is not possible with the registered chemistry)

bz_family.label: SOURCED_SURROGATE_P5_SHAPE_NOT_H1_BZ
bz_family.gap_declared: H-1 B(z) is NOT registered (H1F-BZ-01 TBD_AFTER_EVIDENCE: no FEMM of MC-1, no measured H-1 map). The family below is built only from the two sourced P5 shapes. It is never an H-1 design value (bz_reference rule; HW-H1-03) and never a transport optimum.
bz_family.registration_rule: rigid, never stretched (bridge_lib.jl measured_bfield): B_profile.align = "exit", B_profile.z_ref_in_file_mm = the file z of the first maximum of B (BZ-P5B16 28.23 mm, BZ-P5B30 30.40 mm), so the shape peak sits at the H-1 exit plane z = L (the H1F-BZ-02 peak position 'at or just downstream of z = L'); B_profile.scale_to = "max" with B_ref_T = B_peak_G x 1e-4. Upstream of the first file point and downstream of the last, HallThruster.jl holds B constant (no tail is invented by the bridge).
bz_family.what_stays_p5: the gradient, the width of the high-field region and the anode-to-peak ratio (0.201 for BZ-P5B16, 0.257 for BZ-P5B30) are P5 properties, not H-1 properties
bz_family.classification_effect: ASYMMETRIC (existence versus universality). A Hall closure found under the surrogate is a demonstrated existence of a closing model configuration whose field is a sourced, realised (P5) shape scaled into the H-1 FEMM target band: it is eligible for SELECT_WITH_EVIDENCE_CONDITIONS with the explicit evidence condition EC-BZ (H-1 B(z) from FEMM / measurement realises a field of this class). A Hall non-closure under the surrogate does NOT show that no H-1 field closes, because the surrogate family is not shown to be favorable (bounding) for H-1: it is recorded as HALL_NON_CLOSING_UNDER_SURROGATE_BZ and is NOT eligible for PHYSICALLY_NON_CLOSING (the classification is then NOT_DETERMINABLE with blocker H1_BZ_NOT_REGISTERED). A future envelope version with an H-1-registered B(z) family (kind H1_REGISTERED) makes Hall non-closure eligible.

numerical_settings.label: NUMERICAL_ADEQUACY_NOT_VERIFIED_FOR_H1 (hall_transport_v2_prereg_DRAFT RG-04 open)
numerical_settings.basis: the only registered settings are the P5-N2 campaign settings (cases/p5_n2.json: 200 cells over 0.1 m, dt 5e-9 s, 2e-3 s, averaging from 1e-3 s); they are carried to H-1 by the rules below (same cell size, same base timestep, same number of domain transit times)
numerical_settings.domain_m: L_m + (z_last_mm - z_peak_mm) x 1e-3 of the B shape (the domain ends at the last sourced B datum after registration): BZ-P5B16 L + 0.06603 m, BZ-P5B30 L + 0.06622 m
numerical_settings.wall_and_ions: bridge defaults as in P5-N2 v1: WallSheath(BNSiO2, 1.0), ion_wall_losses = false, HallThruster.jl defaults otherwise

favorable_but_defensible.definition: The favorable-but-defensible (FBD) Hall envelope of a family is the set of HallThruster.jl outcomes over the preregistered grid, every axis of which is a registered H-1 value or range (geometry analysis points, V_d band, delivered-flow values, B_peak band) or a registered / sourced assumption (transport: the nine screening candidates within a <= 1/16; B(z): the two sourced P5 shapes registered peak-at-exit), evaluated favorably: (1) existence over the grid: a constraint closes in the envelope if ANY grid point closes it (maximum over geometry, B shape, B_peak, V_d, flow and transport candidate); (2) the thrust observable is the HallThruster.jl time-averaged thrust_N with no plume-divergence loss added beyond what the pinned solver computes; (3) bus power uses P_d (PPU efficiency 1, an upper bound) plus the non-Hall lower bound P_nonHall,LB; (4) only registered evidence: no super-Bohm set, no anom_scale below or above the candidates' values, no retuning, no interpolation between grid points, no extrapolation beyond the grid.
favorable_but_defensible.defensible_means: every input is registered or sourced (cited above); nothing is chosen after seeing a result
favorable_but_defensible.favorable_means_for_non_closure: a non-closure claim additionally requires that every axis family is H-1-registered or demonstrably bounding. In v1 the B(z) family is SOURCED_SURROGATE and the AIR chemistry is N2_PROXY: neither can carry a Hall-driven non-closure (bz_family.classification_effect; families N2_PROXY classification_role).
favorable_but_defensible.not_favorable_by_construction: the transport set is the registered screening set, not a bound on all transport (a < 1/16 sets are not registered); within this preregistration the registered set is the defensible transport space, which is why transport existence over the nine candidates is taken

run_status_rule.basis: structure of hallthruster_bridge/prereg/p5_n2_run_status_rule_v1.json (+ addendum 1) without measured targets: FAIL_VALIDATION does not exist here (no target); extinction is read from the bridge 'sustained' flag of hall_map_schema_v1 (conventions.sustained_min_Id_fraction = 0.01), the registered HallMap performance-trust convention, because the P5 O1 rule needs a measured I_d target

statuses.NUMERICAL_FAILURE: record absent, retcode != "success", converged != true, finite != true, or any of thrust_N, discharge_current_A, discharge_power_W absent or not finite
statuses.OUT_OF_DOMAIN: N2_PROXY only: chemistry_unresolved_rate_files non-empty, or any chemistry_per_reaction extrapolated_fraction null or > 1e-12 (f_out rule, never relaxed); evaluated independently of sustainment. XE: never from chemistry (no validity manifest)
statuses.PASS: none of the above: converged, finite, sustained and chemistry-trustworthy

run_status_rule.counts_as_evaluated_physics: PASS and NOT_SUSTAINED (a numerically valid, in-domain run); OUT_OF_DOMAIN and NUMERICAL_FAILURE are unknowns
run_status_rule.record_rejection: a record whose case_sha256, hallthruster_commit, prereg_lock_sha256 or cases_file_sha256 differs from the frozen values, a duplicate key, an unexpected key or a missing expected key makes the whole envelope ingestion MODEL_ERROR (no partial envelope)

envelope_output_schema.raw_record: one JSON object per case (JSONL, gzip at freeze), written by the driver; raw observables only, no status, no threshold, no verdict

fields.cases_file_sha256: sha256 of the frozen case file
fields.threads_blas: JULIA_NUM_THREADS, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS, MKL_NUM_THREADS, OMP_NUM_THREADS (null if unset)
fields.finite: all I_d samples, thrust and mean I_d finite
fields.chemistry_per_reaction: N2_PROXY: file, limit, extrapolated_fraction, max active energy

envelope_output_schema.frozen_raw: <name>_raw.jsonl.gz + <name>_raw_manifest.json {prereg_lock_sha256, cases_file_sha256, driver_sha256, n_records, raw_sha256, shard sidecars}; the Rust ingestion reads only a frozen, sha-pinned raw file
envelope_output_schema.labels: every ingested quantity carries layer = PARAMETRIC / NOT_VALIDATED, the family label and the bz_family label; Xe records also carry XE_CHEMISTRY_NO_VALIDITY_MANIFEST and XE_FLOW_FROM_H1_ATM_RANGE; every record carries TRANSPORT_EXTRAPOLATED and NUMERICAL_ADEQUACY_NOT_VERIFIED_FOR_H1

hall_specific_closure.scope: per family; state-independent (vacuum runs, no ingestion; the state dependence enters only through the non-Hall inputs)

point_tests.T12: PASS and thrust_N >= HC-01 (engineering_constraints_v1 thrust_sustained_min_mN x 1e-3) and P_bus_fav < HC-03 (p_bus_max_W)
point_tests.T25: PASS and thrust_N >= HC-02 (thrust_capability_mN x 1e-3) and P_bus_fav < HC-03
point_tests.XE_FUNC: PASS and thrust_N > 0 and P_bus_fav < HC-03 (bounded functional Xe capability: a sustained, in-domain discharge with positive thrust inside the bus limit; the >= 12 mN basis is the atmospheric-propellant requirement, HC-01)

constraint_status.CLOSES_IN_ENVELOPE: at least one grid point passes the point test
constraint_status.NON_CLOSING_IN_ENVELOPE: no grid point passes AND every grid point of the family is evaluated physics (PASS or NOT_SUSTAINED)
constraint_status.NOT_DETERMINABLE_IN_ENVELOPE: no grid point passes and at least one grid point is OUT_OF_DOMAIN or NUMERICAL_FAILURE (blockers: their counts)
constraint_status.NOT_EVALUATED: no envelope ingested (HALL_ENVELOPE_NOT_RUN) or the family carries no classification role (AIR: AIR_HALL_O_O2_CHEMISTRY_NOT_ADMITTED)

hall_specific_closure.hardware_consistency: a hardware configuration is (geometry, bz_shape); B_peak, V_d and mdot are operating variables (coil current, discharge voltage, flow). AIR_PRIMARY needs T12 and T25 under one hardware configuration (any transport candidate); the architecture needs one hardware configuration that closes every required mode
hall_specific_closure.margins: for each test: the maximum of (thrust_N - threshold) over PASS points with P_bus_fav < HC-03 and the minimum P_bus_fav over PASS points with thrust_N >= threshold, each with its key; raw quantities with labels, never a verdict
hall_specific_closure.robustness: per hardware configuration: the transport candidates under which some point closes; ROBUST_UNDER_TRANSPORT_SET iff all nine close (A9.31 sec. 23 C); N2_PROXY uses one chemistry configuration (nominal), so no chemistry robustness is claimed

non_hall_inputs.rule: registered in advance: a sourced favorable bound OR an explicit open condition. An open condition can never make a state PHYSICALLY_NON_CLOSING; it blocks feasibility (NOT_DETERMINABLE) until evaluated

The planning-value DOES_NOT_CLOSE (dry known 38.349 kg; wet 40.35 / 43.35 / 48.35 kg at the 2 / 5 / 10 kg Xe planning cases) is reported as information and is NOT eligible for PHYSICALLY_NON_CLOSING (planning allocations alone, HR-07)

state_evaluation.states: the frozen 196-state design set (atmosphere_msis21_orbit_v1_design_states_v2) through the admitted mission hook abep_mission::integration::today::run_admitted (environment EVALUATED per state); required = the set's required flag

state_status_a.PHYSICS_FEASIBLE: every required constraint closes (Hall: CLOSES_IN_ENVELOPE, eligible) at one hardware configuration
state_status_a.PHYSICS_NON_CLOSING: some required constraint is non-closing by evaluated physics AND eligible (Hall: H1_REGISTERED B(z) family and not N2_PROXY; non-Hall: evaluated, not planning)
state_status_a.NOT_DETERMINABLE: otherwise; blockers = the sorted reason codes of every required constraint that is neither eligible-closing nor eligible-non-closing

state_evaluation.non_hall_at_closing_points: when a non-Hall input becomes evaluable it is evaluated at each Hall closing point of the state, and the state is PHYSICS_FEASIBLE only if one hardware configuration closes every required constraint; in v1 every non-Hall input is OPEN, so this case does not arise

two_layer_reporting.layer_a: physics-feasible (PARAMETRIC / NOT_VALIDATED): the FBD envelope plus the non-Hall rules above; every field labelled
two_layer_reporting.layer_b: evidence-qualified / admitted: only admitted components (abep_hall HallGate: credible set; abep_mission run hook; abep_assess RFP constraint matrix; official power ledger; mass record). A state is EVIDENCE_QUALIFIED_FEASIBLE only if every required RFP row reads COMPLIES with determining evidence; with the credible set EMPTY every Hall quantity is NOT_EVALUATED
two_layer_reporting.separation: no layer (a) value, status or count is copied into layer (b) and vice versa; the record carries separate counts n_states_physics_feasible_a and n_states_evidence_qualified_b
two_layer_reporting.a9_31_sec_23: reported per layer where legitimate: feasible state count, robust count, worst state, min/max of thrust, P_bus, I_d, mdot (Hall envelope, layer a), and the statuses of drag, T - D, I_e,cap margin and wet mass (open today)

a9_32_rules.rule_1: if even the favorable but defensible Hall envelope cannot close the RFP constraints -> PHYSICALLY_NON_CLOSING (Hall + RF physically non-closing)
a9_32_rules.rule_2: if a feasible region exists but the credible Hall set remains empty -> SELECT_WITH_EVIDENCE_CONDITIONS (physically feasible but not yet experimentally proven)

procedure: C0: credible set non-empty -> NOT_DETERMINABLE [CREDIBLE_SET_NON_EMPTY_NEW_PREREGISTRATION_REQUIRED] (rule 2's premise is an empty set; layer (b) then governs under its own rules)
C1: no frozen envelope ingested -> NOT_DETERMINABLE [HALL_ENVELOPE_NOT_RUN] plus every open blocker

C2: some required state of some required mode is PHYSICS_NON_CLOSING (eligible, evaluated) -> PHYSICALLY_NON_CLOSING (the RFP constraints are statewise over all required states, so one eligible non-closing required state means the RFP constraints cannot close)

C3: every required state of every required mode is PHYSICS_FEASIBLE, under one hardware configuration, and the credible set is EMPTY -> SELECT_WITH_EVIDENCE_CONDITIONS, with the evidence conditions EC-TRANSPORT (an admitted Hall member), EC-BZ (H-1 B(z) of the surrogate class, when bz_family = SOURCED_SURROGATE), EC-DIV (plume divergence not added), EC-NUM (numerical adequacy for H-1), EC-GEOM (analysis point, not a selection) and every non-Hall evidence item used
C4: otherwise NOT_DETERMINABLE with the blocking list (union of state blockers over required modes, sorted, with state counts)
classification_rule.per_mode: the record also reports the C2 / C3 / C4 outcome per mode (informative; the architecture classification is the procedure above over both required modes)
classification_rule.binding_constraint: per mode, per constraint: the number of required states CLOSES / NON_CLOSING / OPEN; the Hall-specific closure (HALL_* constraints) is reported separately from the non-Hall closure (NH-*) so the binding constraint is visible; first blocker in the order of required_constraints

a9_31_sec_21_category.MODEL_DOMAIN_LIMIT: AIR_HALL_O_O2_CHEMISTRY_NOT_ADMITTED; Hall NOT_DETERMINABLE_IN_ENVELOPE driven by OUT_OF_DOMAIN runs
a9_31_sec_21_category.MISSING_EVIDENCE: every other open condition (HALL_ENVELOPE_NOT_RUN, NO_FROZEN_DESIGN_POINT, NP_ICP_NOT_ADMITTED, BUS_LEDGER_NOT_COMPLETE, HOST_SPACECRAFT_DRAG_ICD_ABSENT, MASS_INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE, THERMAL_LOADS_NOT_EVALUATED, LIFE_NOT_EVALUATED; Hall NOT_DETERMINABLE_IN_ENVELOPE driven by NUMERICAL_FAILURE runs)

classification_rule.today_expected: no envelope exists: classification NOT_DETERMINABLE with HALL_ENVELOPE_NOT_RUN first; every Hall field of layer (a) NOT_EVALUATED (HALL_ENVELOPE_NOT_RUN); layer (b) Hall NOT_EVALUATED (credible set EMPTY); AIR layer (a) stays NOT_EVALUATED (AIR_HALL_O_O2_CHEMISTRY_NOT_ADMITTED) even after the envelope runs, so the architecture classification stays NOT_DETERMINABLE until a Hall O / O2 chemistry or an owner-registered alternative exists

seeds: none: HallThruster.jl runs are deterministic for a fixed input, pin and thread count; no random input is used. Determinism is protected by JULIA_NUM_THREADS = OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS = MKL_NUM_THREADS = OMP_NUM_THREADS = 1 in the workflow and the local script (recorded per run)

execution_provenance.per_shard: a provenance JSON next to the shard output: the JuliaRunSidecar nine fields (julia_version, hallthruster_commit, threads_blas, host, argv, input_sha256, output_sha256, rust_commit, contract_id) plus runner OS
execution_provenance.launch_manifest: launch_manifest_v1.json: driver path and sha256, case file path and sha256, prereg lock sha256, n_cases, n_shards, the exact command per shard; generated by the Rust case generator after this lock
execution_provenance.freeze: the shard outputs are concatenated in key order, gzipped and hashed into <name>_raw_manifest.json before any ingestion (sha-pinned); the Rust harness never reads an unfrozen file
execution_provenance.pin_check: the driver calls check_pin() (bridge_lib.jl) and refuses any other HallThruster.jl commit / version; it also refuses a case file or prereg lock whose sha256 differs from the launch manifest

runtime_estimate.basis: one observed P5-N2 throughput datum: 36 records in about 5 min on 4 parallel shards (HISTORY 2026-09-26 facility attempt 1), i.e. ~30-60 s per N2 run at 200 cells x 0.4 M base steps; cost assumed proportional to cells x duration
runtime_estimate.h1_scaling: domain 0.133-0.273 m -> cells 266-546 and duration 2.66-5.45 ms: 1.8-7.4x the P5-N2 cost (mean ~3.7x)
runtime_estimate.per_run: N2_PROXY ~2 min mean (up to ~4-7 min); XE expected cheaper (one neutral, one ion species); both are estimates, not measurements
runtime_estimate.total: ~4536 runs, of order 100-150 CPU-hours; with 64 single-thread shards about 2-3 h wall per shard

open_owner_questions.question: Accept the asymmetric surrogate-B(z) rule (bz_family.classification_effect): Hall closure under the P5-shape surrogate is eligible for SELECT_WITH_EVIDENCE_CONDITIONS with EC-BZ; Hall non-closure under it is not eligible for PHYSICALLY_NON_CLOSING? (A symmetric rule would need a new preregistration version.)

AIR_PRIMARY: with no Hall O / O2 chemistry the AIR layer (a) stays NOT_EVALUATED and the A9.32 architecture classification cannot leave NOT_DETERMINABLE. Authorize a Hall O / O2 chemistry contract (A9.30 limits O / O2 to the ICP), or register another AIR treatment?
H-1 Xe operating flow: confirm the reuse of the H-1 mass-flow values (XE_FLOW_FROM_H1_ATM_RANGE) or register an Xe flow (XV2-17 / XV2-18).
Non-Hall favorable bounds: register sourced bounds (per-state delivered flow, I_e,cap, CBE mass, host drag) when they exist; until then they are open conditions.
Execution: run the workflow_dispatch workflow (GitHub-hosted runners, ~100-150 CPU-h) or another environment with the pinned Julia stack?
Numerical settings: accept the scaled P5-N2 rule for v1 (labelled NUMERICAL_ADEQUACY_NOT_VERIFIED_FOR_H1) or require a grid-adequacy check (RG-04) first?

change_control: any change to an axis, rule, threshold source, family role or classification step after the lock is a new, dated preregistration version or addendum, registered before the runs it governs; results seen under v1 cannot justify a v1 change
